title: OEIS A003024 and A188457: Bala's exp-integrality conjectures, with Gauss congruences for every q
abstract: For an integer q let a_q(0) = 1 and a_q(n) = Σ_{k=1}^n (−1)^(k+1) C(n,k) q^(k(n−k)) a_q(n−k). Then a_2 is OEIS A003024 (labeled acyclic digraphs) and a_3 is OEIS A188457 (acyclic 2-multidigraphs). The package proves the Gauss congruences a_q(np^r) ≡ a_q(np^(r−1)) (mod p^r) for every integer q, every prime p and all n, r ≥ 1. Hence exp(Σ_{n≥1} a_q(n) xⁿ/n) has integer coefficients for every q. The cases q = 2 and q = 3 are Peter Bala's 2016 conjectures in A003024 and A188457; the first also shows that every term of A188490 is an integer.
